description: Department of Housing Commissioner - Western Province - Amended Establishment of Housing Development Fund No. 03 of 1990 in the Western Province
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations and legal provisions related to housing development aid in the Western Province. It establishes new regulations, repeals previous ones (Gazette No. 1552 and Extraordinary Gazette No. 1916/9), defines terms ("low income earner"), and specifies implementation details. The content focuses on creating a legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
